name: io.github.Servosity/sonicwall-mcp
title: SonicWall MCP
description: Cyber-insurance posture for a whole SonicWall fleet: firmware, advisories, MFA, SSL-VPN exposure

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_MSW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your MySonicWall API key, sent as X-API-KEY. nsm-login (CLI or the nsm_login tool) mints the NSM session token from it, and licence and blind-spots checks read MySonicWall with it. Use an account whose NSM role is read-only.

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_NSM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional override; leave blank. Run `sonicwall-cli nsm-login` (or the nsm_login tool) instead, which saves the token. A pasted token expires after 8 hours (15 minutes idle) and keeps overriding the saved one.

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_REGION
environmentVariables.description: NSM SaaS region in https://nsm-{region}.sonicwall.com: uswest (default) or eucentral for EU portals.

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional; leave blank. Sends every NSM and MySonicWall call to this base URL instead, for tests and mock servers.

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to hide tools that change NSM, MySonicWall or firewall state and refuse non-GET execute calls. Tools still write local state: the response cache, posture snapshots and learning entries.

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Leave blank for Claude Desktop.

environmentVariables.name: SONICWALL_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to NSM and MySonicWall. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
